The '''Icefinger Rise''' was the name given to the plain west of the [[White Maw Pass]] in the [[Glacial Fissure]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], east of the [[Bold Ascent]] and the [[Highmount Ridge]]. The Rise was the site of a number of ice spurs that jutted up from the snow, and was linked by an ice bridge to the [[Chilling Death Spire]].
